draft.text: You came in because you have had acne on your face for 2 years, mainly on your forehead, cheeks, and chin.
You are using a noncomedogenic moisturizer sometimes, but not every day, and you have tried Persa-Gel and washing your face regularly.
We found that you have blackheads, whiteheads, and small, red, raised bumps on your cheeks and chin.
This is likely acne, which is a common skin condition that causes pimples, blackheads, and whiteheads.
The next steps will be discussed during your next visit with your doctor.
